briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and DeepSeek R2 accelerate AGI timelines as compute wars intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has entered a high-stakes phase with frontier labs releasing iterative models weekly. Global funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 achieving 87% on GPQA; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4.1 rolled out. DeepSeek R2 now leads open-source benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins next quarter.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units; Microsoft and xAI announce 100k H100 clusters in Texas and Memphis. Energy constraints delay two Middle East hyperscale projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace single-model alignment efforts by Q4 2026?
